Q6097.reason: Modern law construes 'heirs of his body' as creating a fee simple, so the niece's later conveyance gave her a fee simple.

Q5137.reason: An expert may base an opinion on facts reasonably relied upon by experts in the field, and the doctor followed accepted medical practice.

Q5526.reason: Breaking into the hotel guest's room at night with intent to commit a felony (threat/assault over the debt) constitutes burglary.
